name: Lakpura® API
description:
REST API for the Lakpura mobile app (Android/iOS).

**Authentication** is a JWT Bearer token (HS256). Obtain one from
`POST /auth/login`, then send `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` on every
protected request. Tokens are **stateless** and expire after **1 hour**;
there is no refresh token in v1, so on a `401` re-authenticate via
`/auth/login`.

**Errors** for every endpoint use the shape `{ "error": "message" }`. Branch
on the HTTP status code, not the message text.

Accounts are staff accounts; **self-registration is disabled**
(`/auth/register` always returns 403). Administrators create accounts via
`POST /users/create`.
